svg.title: Shrawani Gawade — contribution garden
svg.desc: shrawaniGawade's contribution calendar from 2025-09-09 to 2026-09-08. 48 total contributions. Weeks run from left to right, Sunday through Saturday top to bottom. Cream squares indicate no contributions; progressively deeper rose shades indicate more contributions, using GitHub's relative contribution levels. Every square includes its date and exact count. A small decorative snake moves across the grid; reduced motion shows the still calendar. Refreshed 2026-09-08 UTC.
svg.text: Each square is a day. Every little step counts.
